Privacy Policy - Bright Pay Technologies

Bright Pay is a mobile wallet and bill payment app. This policy describes the information we handle when you use it.

Information we collect
We collect your name, phone number, email address, date of birth, device identifiers and the details of the bills and transfers you make through the app.

How we use information
We use this information to run your wallet, prevent fraud, provide customer support and send you service updates. We may also use it to show you offers from our partners.

Sharing
We share information with banks, payment networks and service providers who help us deliver the service, and with authorities when the law requires it.

Your choices
You can update your profile information or ask us to delete your account at any time from the app settings.

Storage
We keep transaction records for seven years as required by financial regulations. Other information is deleted when you close your account.

Security
We use encryption, access controls and regular audits to protect the information we hold.

Changes
We will post any changes to this policy on this page.
